statement: Nothing is unpublished, deprecated or deleted, and no dist-tag is changed. Every published npm version and every Maven Central release stays immutable and resolvable, including the versions pinned by AI and DesktopPlatform. The npm latest tag of each retired npm identity stays on 1.0.0-ci.350.1, which was published from the rolled-back commit 74c298c9; it is not admitted as a first-party pin (brief section 10, rolled-back package rule). 1.0.0-SNAPSHOT is the documented mutable development exception: CON.40 neither uploads nor removes it, and the provider may expire old snapshots (docs/maven-central.md). Any registry change needs explicit user approval.
